QuestInfo.name: Ereve Intruder
QuestInfo.0: Somebody rushed in during the briefing for the final test, looking for the Empress.
QuestInfo.1: It was none other than the knights' tactician, Neinheart. Apparently, an intruder has breached Ereve.
QuestInfo.2: There's an intruder in Ereve. What would a knight do in this situation?
